app.title: Google Authenticator Export Tool
app.subtitle: Scan and export your 2FA accounts securely
app.description: Scan Google Authenticator export QR codes and convert them to CSV, JSON, or Bitwarden format.
app.privacyNotice: Your data never leaves your device. All processing is done locally.
app.footer: Made with privacy in mind. No data is ever transmitted.

privacy.title: Privacy First
privacy.description: All processing happens locally in your browser. Your secrets never leave your device.
privacy.noServer: No data is sent to any server

scanner.title: Scan QR Code
scanner.instructions: Position the Google Authenticator export QR code within the frame
scanner.permissionRequired: Camera permission is required to scan QR codes
scanner.permissionDenied: Camera access was denied. Please enable camera permissions in your browser settings.
scanner.permissionDeniedHint: You can still upload an image file containing the QR code.
scanner.noCamera: No camera detected on this device
scanner.noCameraHint: No camera detected on this device. You can upload an image of the QR code instead.
scanner.httpsRequired: Camera access requires a secure connection (HTTPS)
scanner.httpsRequiredHint: Camera access requires a secure connection (HTTPS). Try using the file upload option below.
scanner.cameraBusy: Camera is currently in use by another application
scanner.cameraBusyHint: Close other applications using the camera and try again, or use the file upload option.
scanner.iosPwaUnsupported: Camera is not available in this mode
scanner.iosPwaUnsupportedHint: Camera access is not supported when this app is installed on your home screen. Please use the file upload option to scan your QR code image.
scanner.duplicateScan: This QR code has already been scanned
scanner.invalidQR: This doesn't appear to be a Google Authenticator export QR code
scanner.invalidQRHint: This doesn't appear to be a Google Authenticator export QR code. Make sure you're scanning the export QR code from Google Authenticator (Transfer accounts > Export accounts).
scanner.fileUploadSuggestion: Tip: You can also use the file upload option below to scan a screenshot or saved image of the QR code.

fileUpload.title: Upload QR Code Image
fileUpload.description: Upload an image containing a Google Authenticator export QR code
fileUpload.dropzone: Drag and drop an image here, or click to select
fileUpload.acceptedFormats: Accepted formats: PNG, JPG, GIF, WebP
fileUpload.error: Failed to read QR code from image
fileUpload.noQRFound: No QR code found in the image
fileUpload.fileTooLarge: File is too large. Maximum size is 10MB.
fileUpload.invalidFormat: Invalid file format. Please upload an image file.
